studio-honey.name: Studio honey
studio-honey.description: Warm honey look: pale golden background, deep brown ink, amber accents, soft glass

soft-pastel-lilac-glass.name: Soft pastel lilac glass
soft-pastel-lilac-glass.description: Soft pastel lilac glass with rounder corners and light frost

studio-red-signal.name: Studio red signal
studio-red-signal.description: Bold red theme on a deep ink-black background with a distinctive Syne display face
studio-red-signal.css: :root, body { --blue: #e11d2e; --info: #e11d2e; } a, .link, .tk-tab.on, .tk-tab[aria-selected="true"], .chip.on, .seg .on, .switch.on, .btn.primary, .send, .progress > div, input:focus, textarea:focus, select:focus, button:focus-visible, *:focus-visible { color: #ff4d5e !important; outline-color: #e11d2e !important; border-color: #e11d2e !important; caret-color: #e11d2e !important; } .btn.primary, .send, .switch.on, .seg .on, .chip.on, .progress > div { background: #e11d2e !important; color: #ffffff !important; } .tk-tab.on, .tk-tab[aria-selected="true"] { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #e11d2e !important; } ::selection { background: rgba(225,29,46,.45) !important; } .msg.assistant .md a { color: #ff4d5e !important; }

studio-sakura.name: Studio sakura
studio-sakura.description: Pink sakura look: soft pink background, plum ink, strong sakura pink accent and pink-tinted glass
studio-sakura.css: .backdrop { background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 15%, rgba(255,205,222,.55), transparent 45%), radial-gradient(circle at 85% 80%, rgba(250,190,215,.4), transparent 50%); }

studio-orange-fall.name: Studio orange fall
studio-orange-fall.description: Autumn look: warm dark brown background, cream ink, burnt orange accent and amber glass, with the Newsreader serif for headlines.
studio-orange-fall.css: .btn.primary, .send, .switch.on, .switch[aria-checked="true"], .seg .on, .chip.on, .progress > div { background: #ea6a1f !important; color: #1f1409 !important; border-color: #ea6a1f !important; } ::selection { background: rgba(234,106,31,.45); }

game.name: game
game.description: Adds a /game command that finds an installed game on the PC (Steam, Start menu) that fits the user's mood and launches it in chat.

clock-with-seconds.name: Clock with seconds
clock-with-seconds.description: A clock with seconds in the taskbar tray

focus-mode.name: Focus mode
focus-mode.description: Hide the taskbar until the mouse reaches the bottom

translate.name: Translate
translate.description: A Translate button under every answer; the translation appears right below it
